Definition: from G5228 and G4057; superabundantly, i.e. exceedingly:--beyond measure.
BiblicalUsage: hyperperissōs is a plain word for beyond measure. In Mark 7:37, the text says "And were beyond measure astonished."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, hyperperissōs means beyond measure, nothing more and nothing less.
RelatedEvents: Jesus Heals a Deaf and Mute Man in the Decapolis
